independence_limit: Root selected the historical inputs and has seen some returned global lane findings. This is a separately recorded source/render review contract, not a blind independent perceptual study. It was not supplied to case extractors.
scope: Visible components, geometry, relations, lighting, color, capture and crop only. No identity, same-person, demographic, attractiveness or user-preference scoring.
decision_rule: Any material P0/P1 failure prevents an overall fidelity pass. Structural and prompt checks cannot substitute for pixels. One sample per case cannot establish comparative improvement.
